limitations_and_boundaries: The study focuses on murine hair follicle placode development; generalizability to other organs or species is not established.
The direct versus indirect effect of mechanical forces on Sox9 expression remains unresolved.
The vertex model simplifies complex tissue mechanics and may not capture all molecular details.
In vitro experiments (microfabricated substrates, collagen compression) may not fully replicate in vivo conditions.
The role of other MMPs or proteases beyond MMP-2 and MMP-14 was not exhaustively tested.
The selected source chunks do not report a rescue, reconstitution, reversal, or epistasis experiment; that rung of the causal evidence chain remains untested within this extraction scope.
